title: Running the copying machine
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}$ be distinct indices among the $k$ work tapes. For any family $w$ of Boolean words on those tapes with $w_{\mathrm{dst}}$ empty, there is a time $T\le 3|w_{\mathrm{src}}|+3$ such that the copying machine, started in its sweep state with tape contents $w$, is not in its done state at any time $t<T$, and at time $T$ it is in its done state with tape contents given by replacing the destination word by $w_{\mathrm{src}}$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a Boolean input word
src and dst are work-tape indices in Fin k
w assigns a Boolean word to each work tape
The destination word w_dst is empty
